item.title: City Council approves AVA Pacific Beach plans to add 138 apartments
item.description: The San Diego City Council recently unanimously approved the AVA Pacific Beach project expansion, which cannot be vetoed by the mayor.

item.title: Kaiser strike in California, Hawaii ends; health care professionals return to work Tuesday
item.description: Union officials called it the "largest open-ended strike of registered nurses and health care professionals in United States history."

item.title: Baja California on alert after death of cartel leader: What you need to know
item.description: The death of Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes, widely known as El Mencho and leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel, has triggered highway blockades, vehicle burnings, and attacks on commercial establishments across at least ten states, including Jalisco, Michoacán, Guanajuato, Tamaulipas, Colima, and Guerrero. item.title: La Jolla’s iconic Mushroom House is now a public nuisance and graffiti canvas. Its future is anyone’s guess
item.description: "The architect designed the house to withstand the strongest forces of nature: earthquakes, landslides, floods, and, of course, teenagers."

item.title: California’s ‘forever speaker’ Nancy Pelosi takes final bow — in heels — at 85
item.description: Pelosi announced earlier this year that she won’t seek reelection to her San Francisco seat, 39 years after her first election to Congress.

item.title: P!NK to headline Curebound’s ‘Concert for Cures’ May 15 at Petco Park
item.description: Global music icon P!NK will "Get the Party Started" for a powerful cause as the headliner of Curebound's annual Concert for Cures on May 15 at Petco Park, organizers announced Monday.

item.title: Threats trigger lockdowns at several San Diego schools, possibly tied to multistate hoaxes
item.description: Apparently unfounded threats of violence -- possibly linked to a recent multi-state series of essentially identical crimes -- prompted lockdowns Monday at several San Diego-area public schools, authorities reported.

item.title: Nearly dead bobcat kitten found in bushes rejoins wild after SD Humane rehab
item.description: A young bobcat that nearly died after being found unresponsive in Orange County has returned to the wild following four months of rehabilitation at the San Diego Humane Society’s Ramona Wildlife Center.

item.title: Historic preservation reforms head to San Diego City Council
item.description: Aiming to speed up a decision that lengthy review process, the Council will consider reforming how the city designates historic properties.

item.title: Spirit of Liberty Foundation kicks off America’s 250th at San Diego Air & Space Museum
item.description: Patriotism and a birthday cake as big as the nation's legacy marked Monday’s debut of Celebrate America 250!, the yearlong observance of the United States’ 250th birthday, at the San Diego Air & Space Museum.
